title: Juniper and the Ghost
author: Theo Montrose
blurb: Mara Fairweather, a whistle-blower living under four names, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must extract a defector who may be the bait before the summit convenes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
